prediction_before_run: The initially unknown grid is built only from local lidar and estimated pose; room extent is a declared grid bound, not a truth obstacle map.
Normal room should permit a direct route to the pre-docking goal; the appearing board should invalidate the direct route and cause a detour planned from scans.
Unknown cells and diagonal corner cutting are blocked; circle footprint, margin and cell half diagonal are included in inflation.
Stale scans, no known-free route, excessive pose covariance or an unsafe local scanned sweep must send zero targets.
Navigation should end near the approach goal and hold still, with truth used only to evaluate pose, clearance and contacts. This does not claim terminal visual docking.
scope: Two sensor-driven navigation module scenarios with ideal lidar, noisy encoders and actual image detections. Reuses EKF, wheel mapping and wheel PI; waypoint heading/distance feedback replaces a fixed time trajectory. No SLAM pose correction, final charging pose, full-task success rate or physical uncertainty calibration.
